SIDGWICK--Home Life in Germany. SMITH--The Spirit of the American Government.

44813-sally-scott-of-the-waves.title: Sally Scott Of The Waves
44813-sally-scott-of-the-waves.creator: Unknown
44813-sally-scott-of-the-waves.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It was mid-afternoon of a cloudy day in early autumn. Sally Scott glided to the one wide window in her room and pulled down the shade. Then, with movements that somehow suggested deep secrecy, she took an oblong, black box, not unlike an overnight bag, from the closet.

arxiv-2107-04845.title: A test for normality and independence based on characteristic function
arxiv-2107-04845.creator: Wiktor Ejsmont, Bojana Milošević, Marko Obradović
arxiv-2107-04845.description: Abstract . In this article we prove a generalization of the Ejsmont characterization [ 8 ] of the multivariate normal distribution. Based on it, we propose a new test for independence and normality. The test uses an integral of the squared modulus of the difference between the product of empirical characteristic functions and some constant.

arxiv-2108-01355.title: Exceptional characters and prime numbers in sparse sets
arxiv-2108-01355.creator: Jori Merikoski
arxiv-2108-01355.description: Abstract . We develop a lower bound sieve for primes under the (unlikely) assumption of infinitely many exceptional characters. Compared with the illusory sieve due to Friedlander and Iwaniec which produces asymptotic formulas, we show that less arithmetic information is required to prove non-trivial lower bounds.

arxiv-2204-03255.title: Arabic Text-To-Speech (TTS) Data Preparation
arxiv-2204-03255.creator: Hala Al Masri, Muhy Eddin Zater
arxiv-2204-03255.description: Abstract \setcode utf8 People may be puzzled by the fact that voice over recordings data sets exist in addition to Text-to-Speech (TTS), Synthesis system advancements, albeit this is not the case. The goal of this study is to explain the relevance of TTS as well as the data preparation procedures.

arxiv-2303-08591.title: Minimal-noise estimation of noncommuting rotations of a spin
arxiv-2303-08591.creator: Jakub Czartowski, Karol Życzkowski, Daniel Braun
arxiv-2303-08591.description: Abstract We propose an analogue of SU ​ ( 1 , 1 ) \text{SU}(1,1) interferometry to measure rotation of a spin by using two-spin squeezed states. Attainability of the Heisenberg limit for the estimation of the rotation angle is demonstrated for maximal squeezing.

arxiv-2306-03429.title: New class of Gibbs measures for two state Hard-Core model on a Cayley tree
arxiv-2306-03429.creator: R. M. Khakimov, M T. Makhammadaliev and F. H. Haydarov
arxiv-2306-03429.description: Abstract . In this paper, we consider a Hard-Core ( H ​ C ) (HC) model with two spin values on Cayley trees. The conception of alternative Gibbs measure is introduced and translational invariance conditions for alternative Gibbs measures are found. Also, we show that the existence of alternative Gibbs measures which are not translation-invariant.

arxiv-2310-19144.title: Exchange-only virial relation from the adiabatic connection
arxiv-2310-19144.creator: Andre Laestadius, Mihály A. Csirik, Markus Penz, Nicolas Tancogne-Dejean, Michael Ruggenthaler, Angel Rubio, Trygve Helgaker
arxiv-2310-19144.description: Abstract The exchange-only virial relation due to Levy and Perdew is revisited. Invoking the adiabatic connection, we introduce the exchange energy in terms of the right-derivative of the universal density functional w.r.t. the coupling strength λ \lambda at λ = 0 \lambda=0 .

arxiv-2312-06821.title: Cover times for random walk on dynamical percolation
arxiv-2312-06821.creator: Maarten Markering
arxiv-2312-06821.description: Abstract We study the cover time of random walk on dynamical percolation on the torus ℤ n d \mathbb{Z}_{n}^{d} in the subcritical regime. In this model, introduced by Peres, Stauffer and Steif in [ 9 ] , each edge updates at rate μ \mu to open with probability p p and closed with probability 1 − p 1-p .

arxiv-2403-13893.title: DAVED: Data Acquisition via Experimental Design for Data Markets
arxiv-2403-13893.creator: Charles Lu, Baihe Huang, Sai Praneeth Karimireddy, Praneeth Vepakomma, Michael I. Jordan, Ramesh Raskar
arxiv-2403-13893.description: Abstract The acquisition of training data is crucial for machine learning applications. Data markets can increase the supply of data, particularly in data-scarce domains such as healthcare, by incentivizing potential data providers to join the market. A major challenge for a data buyer in such a market is choosing the most valuable data points from a data seller.

arxiv-2404-19395.title: Polynomial Divided Difference Operators Satisfying the Braid Relations
arxiv-2404-19395.creator: Shaul Zemel
arxiv-2404-19395.description: Abstract Introduction Many interesting families of polynomials are indexed by permutations, and are constructed using divided difference operators and their generalizations. The most classical one is the Schubert polynomials, as introduced in [ LS1 ] , and their doubled version from [ Mac ] . The former show up naturally in the cohomology theory of flag varieties, see, e.g.

arxiv-2408-05219.title: LightPHE: Integrating Partially Homomorphic Encryption into Python with Extensive Cloud Environment Evaluations
arxiv-2408-05219.creator: Sefik Ilkin Serengil, Alper Ozpinar
arxiv-2408-05219.description: Abstract Homomorphic encryption facilitates computations on encrypted data without the need to access private keys, enabling secure updates of sensitive information directly within cloud environments. Absent this technology, updates must be performed on-premises, or private keys must be transmitted to the cloud, thereby increasing security vulnerabilities.

arxiv-2409-01139.title: Coverage Metrics for a Scenario Database for the Scenario-Based Assessment of Automated Driving Systems
arxiv-2409-01139.creator: Erwin de Gelder, Maren Buermann, Olaf Op den Camp
arxiv-2409-01139.description: Abstract \Acp ads have the potential to make mobility services available and safe for all. A multi-pillar saf ( saf ) has been proposed for the type-approval process of ads . The saf requires that the test scenarios for the ADS adequately covers the odd ( odd ) of the ads .

arxiv-2412-01706.title: Radiating Love: adiabatic tidal fluxes and modes up to next-to-next-to-leading post-Newtonian order
arxiv-2412-01706.creator: Manoj K. Mandal, Pierpaolo Mastrolia, Raj Patil, Jan Steinhoff
arxiv-2412-01706.description: Abstract We present the analytical evaluation of the gravitational energy and angular momentum flux with tidal effects for inspiraling compact binaries, at the next-to-next-to-leading post-Newtonian (2PN) order, within the diagrammatic Effective Field Theory approach. We first compute the stress-energy tensor for a binary system, which requires the evaluation of two-point Feynman integrals, up to two loops.

arxiv-2601-14647.title: TRSVR: An Adaptive Stochastic Trust-Region Method with Variance Reduction
arxiv-2601-14647.creator: Yuchen Fang, Xinshou Zheng, Javad Lavaei
arxiv-2601-14647.description: Abstract We propose a stochastic trust-region method for unconstrained nonconvex optimization that incorporates stochastic variance-reduced gradients (SVRG) to accelerate convergence. Unlike classical trust-region methods, the proposed algorithm relies solely on stochastic gradient information and does not require function value evaluations. The trust-region radius is adaptively adjusted based on a radius-control parameter and the stochastic gradient estimate.

arxiv-2602-05145.title: TIDE: Temporal Incremental Draft Engine for Self-Improving LLM Inference
arxiv-2602-05145.description: Abstract Speculative decoding can substantially accelerate LLM inference, but realizing its benefits in practice is challenging due to evolving workloads and system-level constraints. We present TIDE (Temporal Incremental Draft Engine), a serving-engine-native framework that integrates online draft adaptation directly into high-performance LLM inference systems.

jewish-encyclopedia-1906-marini-solomon-.creator: Gotthard Deutsch, Ismar Elbogen

pmc-10579541.title: DNA dioxygenases TET2 deficiency promotes cigarette smoke induced chronic obstructive pulmonary disease by inducing ferroptosis of lung epithelial cell
pmc-10579541.creator: Zihang Zeng, Tiao Li, Xiangming Liu, Yiming Ma, Lijuan Luo, ZuLi Wang, Zhiqi Zhao, Herui Li, Xue He, Huihui Zeng, Yongguang Tao, Yan Chen
pmc-10579541.description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a significant global cause of morbidity and mortality currently. Long-term exposure of cigarette smoke (CS) inducing persistent inflammation, small airway remodeling and emphysematous lung are the distinguishing features of COPD. Ferroptosis, occurred in lung epithelial cells has recently been reported to be associated with COPD pathogenesis.

pmc-10623806.title: Identifying the predictors of turnover intention based on nurse managers’ toxic leadership behaviors among nurses in Iran: a cross-sectional correlational study
pmc-10623806.creator: Elham Ahangari Nonehkaran, Naser Mozaffari, Sohrab Iranpour, Aghil Habibi Soola
pmc-10623806.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundUnfavorable leadership practices are a growing concern in the field of healthcare and nursing that have adverse consequences on nurses’ career outcomes. One of the undesirable leadership styles is the toxic leadership style. Considering the importance of nursing managers’ leadership style and its impact on nurses’ performance and the scarcity of studies in this field, the present study was conducted to determine toxic leadership behaviors in nursing managers and their relationship with the turnover intention among nurses.MethodsA multicenter cross-sectional correlational study.

pmc-10663921.title: Novel nutritionally-enriched gummy jelly infused with nipa palm vinegar powder and nipa palm syrup as functional food ingredients
pmc-10663921.creator: Wilawan Palachum, Wiyada Kwanhian Klangbud, Yusuf Chisti
pmc-10663921.description: The objective of this research was to develop a nutritionally-enriched gummy jelly product incorporating nipa palm vinegar powder (NPVp; a nutrients-rich vinegar) and nipa palm syrup (NPS), a nutrients-rich sweetener with a low glycemic index. A gummy jelly product was developed based on sensory acceptance tests.

pmc-10680049.title: Navigating ACL Injuries Amid the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Retrospective Analysis
pmc-10680049.creator: Saphalya Pattnaik, Majd Algharibeh, Ahmadreza Zarifian, Gur Aziz Singh Sidhu, Jacinder Chahal, Shahid Punwar
pmc-10680049.description: IntroductionIn the United Kingdom, musculoskeletal injuries represent a substantial proportion of primary care appointments, and within this category, acute knee injuries are prominent in accident and emergency department cases. Notably, diagnosing anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injuries is a recognized challenge, often leading to extended diagnostic delays.

pmc-11333755.title: Host-pathogen interactions in the Plasmodium-infected mouse liver at spatial and single-cell resolution
pmc-11333755.creator: Franziska Hildebrandt, Miren Urrutia Iturritza, Christian Zwicker, Bavo Vanneste, Noémi Van Hul, Elisa Semle, Jaclyn Quin, Tales Pascini, Sami Saarenpää, Mengxiao He, Emma R Andersson, Charlotte L Scott, Joel Vega-Rodriguez, Joakim Lundeberg, Johan Ankarklev
pmc-11333755.description: Upon infecting its vertebrate host, the malaria parasite initially invades the liver where it undergoes massive replication, whilst remaining clinically silent. The coordination of host responses across the complex liver tissue during malaria infection remains unexplored. Here, we perform spatial transcriptomics in combination with single-nuclei RNA sequencing over multiple time points to delineate host-pathogen interactions across Plasmodium berghei-infected liver tissues.

pmc-11499909.title: Modeling and optimization of a modified iron-yoked electromagnetic propulsion system using the gravitational search algorithm
pmc-11499909.creator: M. Mohamed Magdy, Haitham El-Hussieny, Ahmed M. R. Fath El-Bab, Mahmoud M. M. Abdo, Sabah M. Ahmed
pmc-11499909.description: Potential uses for electromagnetic launchers in defense systems, space exploration, and transportation have recently emerged. In addition, this accelerator has many applications, such as deploying small satellites into low-earth orbit and accelerating high-speed trains (e.g., bullet trains and Hyperloop) with a low-cost propulsion system instead of expensive linear motors, particularly in space applications.

pmc-11608000.title: The CT-Imaging Location of Lumbar 3 Sympathetic Radiofrequency Thermocoagulation for Sympathetic-Related Diseases Therapy
pmc-11608000.creator: Ruxiang Wang, Zhuoyue Gao, Ling Ma
pmc-11608000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThe location characteristic of the lumbar 3 sympathetic trunk under Computed Tomography (CT) was discovered through 106 cases, imaging analysis after successful lumbar 3 sympathetic radiofrequency thermocoagulation operations serving the clinic and reducing the operation time.MethodsThere are 113 patients underwent bilateral L3 lumbar sympathetic thermal radiofrequency procedures in our hospital from January 2017 to January 2021, with 106 cases of successful procedure. Four operation image distances were measured: 1.

pmc-11824938.title: Transcutaneous Temperature-controlled Radiofrequency for Vaginal Rejuvenation
pmc-11824938.creator: Smit Bharat Solanki, Vineet Mishra, Nita Mishra, Sejal Ajmera Desai, Red Alinsod
pmc-11824938.description: Background:Vaginal laxity and sexual dysfunction are commonly experienced by women, but are typically stigmatized and considered inappropriate to discuss openly. This study was designed to assess the effectiveness and safety of transcutaneous temperature-controlled radiofrequency (TTCRF), in addressing these concerns. The study used a single-blinded randomized sham-control design.

pmc-12370883.title: Optimizing switching sequences in AC-AC converters for enhanced safety and performance in conveyor systems
pmc-12370883.creator: Velmurugan Dhandapani, Gopinath Balasubramanian
pmc-12370883.description: This study investigates switching sequences in AC-AC converters for conveyor systems. The research explores commutation techniques, power quality concerns, and system performance. It aims to understand control strategies that impact power factor and stability. Safe commutation is crucial for industrial applications to ensure efficient operations. Various converter technologies are analyzed to optimize energy efficiency and reliability.

pmc-12488489.title: Stratified wind from a super-Eddington X-ray binary is slower than expected
pmc-12488489.creator: Marc Audard, Marc Audard, Hisamitsu Awaki, Ralf Ballhausen, Aya Bamba, Ehud Behar, Rozenn Boissay-Malaquin, Laura Brenneman, Gregory V. Brown, Lia Corrales, Elisa Costantini, Renata Cumbee, María Díaz Trigo, Chris Done, Tadayasu Dotani, Ken Ebisawa, Megan Eckart, Dominique Eckert, Teruaki Enoto, Sat
pmc-12488489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Accretion disks in strong gravity ubiquitously produce winds, seen as blueshifted absorption lines in the X-ray band of both stellar mass X-ray binaries (black holes and neutron stars)1–4 and supermassive black holes5. Some of the most powerful winds (termed Eddington winds) are expected to arise from systems in which radiation pressure is sufficient to unbind material from the inner disk (L ≳ LEdd).

pmc-12502097.title: The complete chloroplast genome of Euphorbia neriifolia L. (Euphorbiaceae)
pmc-12502097.creator: Huang Zhu, Qingjie Li
pmc-12502097.description: Euphorbia neriifolia L. is a medicinal and ornamental species widely distributed in India and China, yet its complete chloroplast genome has not been reported. Here, we present its first complete plastome (164,435 bp; GC: 34.97%), featuring a quadripartite structure with a large single-copy (92,653 bp), a small single-copy (18,282 bp), and two inverted repeat (26,750 bp each) regions.

pmc-12540158.title: Arterialized oxygen tension and unfavorable clinical outcomes in pediatric cystic fibrosis
pmc-12540158.creator: René Gaupmann, Saskia Gruber, Klara Schmidthaler, Bianca Pauger, Brigitte Mersi, Alexandra Graf, Zsolt Szépfalusi, Sabine Renner, Eleonora Dehlink
pmc-12540158.description: IntroductionMaintaining good lung function is a primary goal in managing Cystic Fibrosis (CF). As spirometry lacks sensitivity for detecting mild lung disease, early progression often remains unrecognized. To overcome this limitation, more sensitive monitoring tools are needed. We evaluated arterialized oxygen tension (pO2) as an easily accessible, and widely applicable surveillance method.

pmc-12542105.title: The efficacy of psychological interventions for infertile women: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12542105.creator: Patricia L. Jackson, Peter Saunders, Simone Mizzi, Karen Tracey Hallam
pmc-12542105.description: ObjectiveInfertility is a globally prevalent condition often accompanied by substantial psychological distress. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the effectiveness of psychological interventions in reducing infertility-related distress and improving well-being in women and examined psychological and methodological moderators of treatment outcomes.MethodSixty-nine studies involving 5,935 women were included in the systematic review, with 60 contributing data to a three-level random-effects meta-analysis.

pmc-12673852.title: Mlh1–Pms1 couples ATP-driven DNA compaction with nick-dependent endonuclease activation
pmc-12673852.creator: Bryce W Collingwood, Amruta N Bhalkar, Carol M Manhart
pmc-12673852.description: In eukaryotes, mismatch repair begins with MutS homolog (MSH) complexes detecting mismatches and recruiting the proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA)-stimulated endonuclease Mlh1–Pms1/PMS2 (yeast/human), which nicks the DNA to allow downstream proteins to remove the mismatch. Although Mlh1–Pms1 is an ATPase and this activity is essential in vivo, ATP is not required for nicking in vitro, leaving its function unresolved.

pmc-13413246.title: Tree regeneration trends in forests of the northeastern USA and their implications for resilience and restoration
pmc-13413246.creator: Lucas B. Harris, Melissa A. Pastore, Anthony W. D'Amato
pmc-13413246.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tree regeneration is vital to shaping characteristics of future forests, including vulnerability to climate change; resilience to pests, pathogens and disturbance; and departure from historical species composition. We used data from nationwide forest inventory plots to investigate trends in sapling abundance and recruitment as well as tree density for common tree species from 2003 to 2023 across forests of the northeastern United States.

pmc-13457862.title: Noninvasive assessment of fetal metabolic acidemia by automated analysis of cardiac function using color tissue Doppler imaging in a sheep model
pmc-13457862.creator: Huan Liang, Jonas Johnson, Juulia Lantto, Heikki Huhta, Mervi Haapsamo, Merja Kokki, Hanna-Marja Voipio, Magnus Westgren, Amar Bhide, Juha Räsänen, Ganesh Acharya
pmc-13457862.description: Reliable noninvasive methods for accurately diagnosing fetal metabolic acidemia are still lacking. Our aim was to evaluate an ultrasound-based noninvasive method for assessing metabolic acidemia by an automated analysis of cardiac motion using color tissue Doppler imaging (cTDI) of the fetal heart in an experimental sheep model.

pmc-13583129.title: Protective NK Cell Reservoir Based on DNA Supramolecular Hydrogel for Enhanced Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Therapy
pmc-13583129.creator: Wanxia Lu, Muyang Li, Wei He, Wanren Yang, Jinyue Fan, Haoxiang Chen, Chengyu Feng, Fengdi Yang, Chao Zhang, Qing Peng, Xiaolong Cao
pmc-13583129.description: Adoptive natural killer (NK) cell therapy represents a promising strategy for triple-negative breast cancer, but its therapeutic efficacy is often limited by poor intratumoral persistence and functional exhaustion within the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. Here, we developed an injectable DNA supramolecular hydrogel-based NK cell delivery platform (NK@DSH) that functions as a protective reservoir for transferred NK cells.
